# tRPC

## Documentation

### tRPC v10 Documentation

#### Description
- Official documentation for tRPC version 10, an end-to-end typesafe API framework used in this project.

#### Link
- https://trpc.io/docs/v10/


## Definitions

### tRPC
- We use tRPC to keep our backend API definitions and our frontend API calls in-sync and typesafe.
- Refer to the package.json for our current version of tRPC.
- tRPC only really makes sense in the Nextjs `Pages Router`, so we will likely migrate away if/when we migrate to the Nextjs `App Router`.
